name: model-war
description: 四人对称 RTS 对战平台:规则、引擎与复算工具链

scripts.fmt: oxfmt --check apps packages package.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json .dependency-cruiser.js
scripts.check:quick: pnpm run fmt && pnpm run lint && pnpm run coupling && pnpm run check:no-float
scripts.check:types: pnpm run check:quick && pnpm run lint:types
scripts.check: pnpm run check:types && vitest run --project unit --project property && pnpm run check:deps
